jobs.title: Senior Product Intelligence Analyst, Product Management
jobs.location: LOC3347:9-10/F, Building N1, Fusion New Bund, No. 8, Lane 131, New Bund Avenue, Pudong, Shanghai, China
jobs.description:
Date Posted:
2026-08-24 Country:
China Location:
LOC3347:9-10/F, Building N1, Fusion New Bund, No. 8, Lane 131, New Bund Avenue, Pudong, Shanghai, China 工作职责 | Responsibilities
一、产品机会情报（约40%）
1. Product Opportunity Intelligence (~40%)
- 搭建并运营自动化数据采集体系，覆盖政府投资公告、项目批复、土地出让、招投标平台、行业媒体等数据源

Build and operate automated data collection pipelines covering government investment announcements, project approvals, land transactions, tender platforms, and industry media
- 利用LLM解析非结构化文档（招标文件、政府批文、行业报告），提取关键信息

Apply LLMs to parse unstructured documents (tender documents, government approvals, industry reports) and extract key information
- 建立重点项目早期预警机制，向销售团队推送高价值线索

Establish early-warning mechanisms for key projects, delivering high-value leads to the sales team
二、竞争与投标分析（约30%）
2. Competitive & Bid Analysis (~30%)
- 持续追踪主要竞争对手的中标动态、市场策略和产品动向，输出定期简报

Track competitors' contract awards, market strategies, and product moves; deliver regular intelligence briefings
- 采集、清洗、结构化投标数据，支持成标/丢标分析，为Pricing团队提供数据输入

Collect, clean, and structure bidding data to support win/loss analysis and provide data inputs for the Pricing team
三、知识库与AI工具建设（约30%）
3. Knowledge Base & AI Tooling (~30%)
- 协助搭建各国电梯标准与工程偏差（deviation）知识库（RAG应用）：将工程团队的历史案例与各国标准文档工具化，供海外销售快速查询"工厂改造 vs 现场改造"等决策参考（工程判断由工程团队提供并审核）

Help build a knowledge base (RAG application) of country-specific elevator codes and engineering deviations: turn the engineering team's historical cases and standards documents into a queryable tool for overseas sales, covering decision references such as "factory vs. field modification" (engineering judgments provided and validated by the engineering team)
- 主动识别销售及产品流程中可自动化、可AI赋能的环节，快速构建原型并推动落地

Proactively identify sales and product processes that can be automated or AI-enabled; rapidly prototype and implement solutions

任职要求 | Qualifications
必须项 | Must-haves
- 本科及以上学历，计算机、数据科学、统计、信息管理或相关专业

Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Information Management, or related fields
- 5年以上数据分析/数据工程经验，有端到端独立交付的项目经历（从数据采集到分析呈现），能独立对接业务方并推动方案落地

5+ years in data analytics/data engineering, with proven end-to-end project delivery experience (from data acquisition to analysis and presentation); able to independently engage business stakeholders and drive solutions to implementation
- 熟练使用Python，有扎实的自动化数据采集实战经验（Scrapy/Requests/Playwright等）

Proficiency in Python with solid hands-on experience in automated data collection (Scrapy/Requests/Playwright, etc.)
- 有LLM应用落地经验：熟悉主流大模型API、Prompt设计、文档解析（OCR/RAG）

Practical LLM application experience: mainstream LLM APIs, prompt engineering, document parsing (OCR/RAG)
- 熟悉中国公开数据生态（政务公开平台、招投标平台、企业信息查询等）

Familiarity with China's public data ecosystem (government disclosure platforms, tender platforms, corporate registries, etc.)
- 良好的英文读写能力（涉及国际标准文档及海外市场信息）

Good written English proficiency (for international standards documentation and overseas market information)
- 良好的沟通与汇报能力，能将业务需求转化为技术方案，并向管理层清晰呈现业务价值

Strong communication and presentation skills; able to translate business needs into technical solutions and articulate business value to senior leadership
加分项 | Nice-to-haves
- 有pricing model、win/loss分析或B2B报价场景经验

Experience with pricing models, win/loss analysis, or B2B bidding scenarios
- 有工业品、建筑、房地产等B2B行业的市场情报/商业分析经验

Market intelligence or business analytics background in B2B industries (industrial equipment, construction, real estate)
- 有数据可视化经验（Power BI/Tableau等）

Data visualization skills (Power BI/Tableau)
- 硕士学历

Master's degree

jobs.title: Director, APAC Product Operations for Digital Services & Products
jobs.location: Otis Elevator Company (M) Sdn Bhd, 15-01 Menara Symphony, No 5, Jalan Semangat, Seksyen 13, 46200 Petaling Jaya, Selangor Darul Ehsan , Malaysia
jobs.description:
Date Posted:
2026-07-21 Country:
Malaysia Location:
Otis Elevator Company (M) Sdn Bhd, 15-01 Menara Symphony, No 5, Jalan Semangat, Seksyen 13, 46200 Petaling Jaya, Selangor Darul Ehsan , Malaysia Role Overview
The Director, APAC Product Operations for Digital Services & Products is responsible for driving the successful deployment, adoption, operationalization, and growth of Otis digital products across the Asia Pacific region, including Otis ONE™, Customer Portal, Developer Portal, EMS Panorama™, Compass® 360, Compass® Infinity, and future digital solutions.

This role serves as the critical link between Global Product teams and APAC business stakeholders, ensuring regional priorities, customer requirements, and market needs are effectively represented. The incumbent will drive cross-functional collaboration across Product Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, Field Operations, Sales, Service, New Equipment (NE), Modernization (MOD), and Customer Success functions to enable successful product deployment, accelerate adoption, improve operational performance, and support regional growth objectives.

The Director will champion change management initiatives, establish operational excellence programs, monitor key business metrics, and enable successful execution of digital strategies throughout the region.

Key Responsibilities
- Represent APAC business needs and customer requirements to Global Digital Product teams, influencing product roadmaps and priorities.
- Drive deployment, adoption, and operational excellence for digital products across APAC markets.
- Develop and execute regional go-to-market strategies in partnership with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Service organizations.
- Lead product growth initiatives and drive commercial performance through data-driven decision making.
- Partner with regional and country leadership teams to remove operational barriers and accelerate digital transformation.
- Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), ensuring alignment with business objectives and measurable outcomes.
- Lead cross-functional governance and stakeholder engagement to ensure regional alignment and execution excellence.
- Support sales enablement activities, customer engagement programs, and product evangelization across the region.
- Drive change management, user adoption, and organizational readiness initiatives for digital product implementation.
- Build strong partnerships with global teams while balancing regional priorities and business requirements.

Required Qualifications & Experience
- Bachelor's Degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Product Management, or a related field.
- Master's Degree or MBA preferred.
- 15+ years of professional experience in Product Operations, Product Management, Digital Transformation, Program Management, Technology Solutions, or related functions.
- Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing regional or multi-country initiatives across APAC.
- Proven experience driving deployment and adoption of enterprise digital products, SaaS platforms, IoT solutions, or connected services.
- Demonstrated success working within complex, matrixed global organizations.
- Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting go-to-market execution and growth initiatives.
- Experience influencing senior stakeholders and executive leadership teams across multiple functions and geographies.

Skills & Competencies
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
- Excellence in stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership.
- Outstanding communication, presentation, and influencing skills.
- Strong program and project management expertise.
- Ability to drive organizational change and manage transformation initiatives.
- Customer-focused mindset with a passion for digital innovation and operational excellence.
- Experience working in Agile environments; Agile certifications are advantageous.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.
- Demonstrated ability to work independently and efficiently in a highly matrixed organization, driving results while collaborating remotely with stakeholders across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones.
- Strong ability to influence, align, and build relationships without direct authority across regional and global teams.
